what: NEUTRON STAR chip sits beside the 10^33-10^36 ticks, not at its rung (lesson 33).
evidence: From f745 the chip stacks above SUN at y~385-445 (full res), level with the 10^36/10^33 labels. A neutron star (~2.8e30 kg) belongs at the 10^30 rung, where the marker correctly stays and the counter reads 30. On a phone the leader line is too thin to beat the chip's position, so a first-time viewer reads the neutron star as ~10^33-10^36. From f1014 SGR A* stacks above it, which makes it worse.
suggested_fix: Put the neutron chip to the right of the SUN chip on the 10^30 line, or make it a 'SUN / NEUTRON STAR' shared rung chip; keep stacked chips out of the y-band of other powers' tick labels.
